newsitem.title: UK: UK's FTSE opens steady, ignores Wall St record.
newsitem.headline: UK's FTSE opens steady, ignores Wall St record.

text.p: The British stock market opened Thursday on a steady but uninspired note as investors ignored Wall Street's record overnight and fretted about next week's budget, sterling's strength and interest rates.

The FTSE 100 index was up 2.7 points at 3,965.5 around 15 minutes after the start of official trade. Dealers said the market got off to quiet start, propped by firm gilts prices but sceptical of Wall Street's 0.51 percent rise.
"There's not too much on the corporate front today and we're looking at a quiet day. I can't see volumes picking up. You could say we're in budget limbo," one dealer said.
